sm_kid.instruct: A 10-year-old American boy, bright clear childish voice, curious and playful, natural, close to the microphone.
sm_kid.ref: Wait, what? Who sent this? Is this a joke?

sm_old.instruct: An 80-year-old American man, warm gentle raspy voice, slow, kind grandfatherly tone, a soft smile in the voice.
sm_old.ref: Well, look at that. It has been a long, long time.

lines.emo: Puzzled, reading a strange note, each word a confused question.

lines.text: Are we rich? Are we famous?
lines.emo: Excited and hopeful, quick, writing while talking.
Shouting happily out of a window, excited.

lines.text: Hello, future me. Are we rich? Are we famous?
lines.emo: Reading a child's note aloud slowly, amused, a smile in the voice.
Tender, nostalgic, slow, a little emotional, like advice to a grandchild.
Stunned amazed whisper, slowly realizing, the end rises in disbelief.
Amused, gently teasing, a soft little chuckle, like smiling at his younger self.
Soft, warm, smiling, calm and certain, not sad at all.
Slow, drawn out, whispered with deep love and quiet happiness, a smile you can hear, savoring the word, holding the hand of his wife.
